# Synthetic Colab execution and retrieval test

CPU only. No patient data, Drive mount or credentials. Run All manually, or ask
Colab MCP to execute the cells and retrieve the result. A browser connection
alone is not success: preserve returned output from both operations.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys
PIN = 'd6a1184b4378e849213fd887a6f7b103fb1a64d5'
REPO = Path('/content/scout-pilot-' + PIN[:12])
if not REPO.exists():
    subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(REPO)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'remote', 'add', 'origin', 'https://github.com/Moroseui/concept-research-scout.git'], cwd=REPO, check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'config', 'remote.origin.fetch', '+refs/heads/astra/autonomous-isles-pilot:refs/remotes/origin/astra/autonomous-isles-pilot'], cwd=REPO, check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', 'origin', PIN], cwd=REPO, check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'checkout', '--detach', PIN], cwd=REPO, check=True)
if subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip() != PIN:
    raise RuntimeError('Source pin mismatch')
if subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip():
    raise RuntimeError('Modified or untracked code; use a fresh checkout')
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO))

# Supplementary MCP transport cell (not part of pinned synthetic_execution.ipynb):
# re-runs only the read-only 'retrieve' operation so its JSON reaches the MCP channel,
# plus token-free runtime evidence. The synthetic write above is not repeated.
import json, os, platform, shutil, subprocess, sys
retrieved = subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, str(REPO/'campaigns/isles24-pilot/colab/smoke.py'), 'retrieve'], text=True)
print(retrieved, end='')
print(json.dumps({'colab_release_tag': os.environ.get('COLAB_RELEASE_TAG'), 'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'uname_release': platform.release(), 'nvidia_smi_present': shutil.which('nvidia-smi') is not None, 'content_dir_exists': os.path.isdir('/content')}))
